replication.target_description: Supplied description links problem solving, awareness of knowledge gaps, and conceptual understanding but does not specify a factor, contrast, outcome measure, or test. reported_success.quote:
While we failed to replicate the findings of Loibl and Rummel (2014a) in our conceptual
replication study, our results do not contradict the theoretical assumptions made by Loibl
and Rummel.
